data.one_liner: Utility for generating 3D geometry and materials for the simple_3d package.
data.what_it_does: Provides utilities to easily generate 3D geometry shapes like cubes, spheres, capsules, cones, circles, tiles, and pillars, along with default materials and coordinate arrows for the simple_3d package.
use_when: You are building a 3D application using the simple_3d package and need pre-built geometry generators.
You want quick default materials, wireframes, and world meshes for 3D objects.
avoid_when: You are using a heavy production 3D game engine like Flame or custom OpenGL wrappers.
You do not use the simple_3d package.
strengths: Simplifies 3D geometry creation with ready-to-use shape methods.
Includes helpful common parts like coordinate arrows and world meshes.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the simple_3d package ecosystem.
Limited documentation outside of basic geometry examples.
